_doc: DERIVED. Contours for the 'us' scope, built by tools/build-contours.py from USGS 3DEP elevation (rasterFunction None, public domain). Interval 1000m minor / 2000m major, sampled on a 1400x616 grid, simplified at 0.0008 deg. Elevation range -483-8849m over 94.5% of the box. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
